name: Jokei Kazoku no Inu ni Natta Boku
original_name: 女系家族の犬になった僕
source:
Yuuki Shimazaki finds himself in the care of an all female household after his parents die.
They all seemed so kind at first, but something perversely changes.

He can't help but lust for them.
Their hot bodies, their beautiful legs and arms, hair, clothes, even their excretions.
Pride lost, he can only find excitement in the different in level between himself and them.
No matter how hard he works, no matter how much money he has, it won't measure up.

At this point, the only thing for a man to do, is be turned into the dog they are.

And so the naive Yuuki was toyed with by these girls who see his true nature.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE281393.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
父母去世后，岛崎优纪发现自己由一个全是女性的家庭照顾。
起初他们看起来都很友善，但有些事情却发生了反常的变化。

他无法抑制对它们的渴望。
她们火辣的身体，她们美丽的腿和手臂，头发，衣服，甚至她们的排泄物。
骄傲失去了，他只能在自己与他们的等级差距中寻找刺激。
无论他多么努力，无论他有多少钱，都达不到要求。

此时，人唯一能做的，就是变成狗。

就这样，天真的有纪被这些看清他本性的女孩们玩弄了。
